description.fun: Gothita stares, unblinking and utterly silent, at things nobody else can see, and even when no one seems to be around it can be heard making a muted cry, as if talking to something invisible. Its ribbonlike feelers store its psychic power, so don't touch them: Gothita will start bawling. Its look seems to draw on Gothic Lolita fashion, and its name may be a contraction of it.
description.guide: Gothita is a Psychic-type Pokémon that resembles a small child in Gothic Lolita fashion and is always staring at something. Its ribbonlike feelers hold its psychic power. It evolves into Gothorita, then Gothitelle.
description.tagline: A tiny goth who stares at things only it can see.

description.fun: Gothorita draws its power from starlight, and on starry nights it floats pebbles with its mind to arrange them into constellations. Tales told in every corner warn of it hypnotising people and leading them astray, and of it carrying off sleeping children on bright starry nights, which is why some call it the Witch of Punishment. Some people even believe it came from outer space. It stands for September in the Unova horoscope.
description.guide: Gothorita is the evolved form of Gothita, a Psychic-type Pokémon whose power comes from starlight. It can hypnotise people and Pokémon. It evolves into Gothitelle.
description.tagline: A star-powered witch said to spirit away sleeping children.

description.fun: Gothitelle reads the future in the movement of the stars, and it can even see its Trainer's life span, which makes it cry with sadness. Its psychic power bends space so that starry skies thousands of light-years away appear around it. Having glimpsed the end of all existence, it acts a little detached, and it dislikes conflict. Its silhouette may also nod to the Flatwoods monster, a cryptid popular in Japan.
description.guide: Gothitelle is the final form of Gothita, a Psychic-type Pokémon that predicts the future from the movement of the stars. Its psychic power is immense, but it dislikes conflict.
description.tagline: A stargazing fortune teller who has seen the end of everything.
